title: the elven deity prose
audit_comment: THE ELVEN DEITY PROSE - part 2 of the Appendix S description-paragraph close. The archive.org full-text OCR of pp. 113-116 reads the five elven blocks scan-clean: the Aerdrie wind blasts and air summons, the Erevan tricks and twenty small helpers, the Solonor never-empty quiver and slaying arrows, the Hanali Evergold pool and charm aura, and the Labelas time powers - temporal stasis, the 100-year touch, and the 18-inch slow and haste radius. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph facts ride rules/uadeityprose2.h.

banner.title: THE ELVEN DEITY PROSE - part 2 of the Appendix S paragraph close: Aerdrie, Erevan, Solonor, Hanali, and Labelas pin from the clean archive.org OCR read
banner.provenance: Part 2 of the five-part close (R786 opened it with the dwarves). The five elven blocks (pp. 113-116) read scan-clean in the archive.org full-text OCR: every pin below is the printed text. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph-level facts pin here - the combat abilities (wind blasts, elementals, the +5 longbow), the special powers (stasis, the Evergold, the charm aura), and the worship customs (the feather-fall quest, the slaying-arrow gift, the charisma gift). Parts 3-5 remain: the halflings, gnomes, and orcs.

consts.name: udp2ProseRound
consts.comment: The prose round: part 2, the elven paragraphs

consts.name: udp2StatblockFeederRound
consts.comment: The feeder round: the R406 stat blocks these paragraphs hang under

consts.name: udp2ElvenDeityCount
consts.comment: The elven census: five blocks described (Aerdrie, Erevan, Solonor, Hanali, Labelas)

consts.name: udp2AerWindBlastsPerRound
consts.comment: If aroused for battle she casts two great blasts of wind per round

consts.name: udp2AerWindBlastDamageMin
consts.comment: Each blast causes 5-20 points of damage: the minimum 5

consts.name: udp2AerWindBlastDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 20

consts.name: udp2AerWindBlastRangeInches
consts.comment: against any opponent within 96 inches of her

consts.name: udp2AerElementalsPerDay
consts.comment: She may summon air elementals once per day

consts.name: udp2AerElementalsMin
consts.comment: at least 2 elementals

consts.name: udp2AerElementalsMax
consts.comment: and at most 12

consts.name: udp2AerElementalHitDice
consts.comment: each with 16 hit dice

consts.name: udp2AerEaglesPerDay
consts.comment: She may summon giant eagles or rocs twice per day

consts.name: udp2AerEaglesMin
consts.comment: 3-18 giant eagles: the minimum 3

consts.name: udp2AerEaglesMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 18

consts.name: udp2AerRocsMin
consts.comment: or 1-2 rocs: the minimum 1

consts.name: udp2AerRocsMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 2

consts.name: udp2AerAirSpellLevel
consts.comment: She uses all air, weather, flight, electricity, and gas magic-user spells at the 25th level of ability

consts.name: udp2AerNegateFlightRadiusInches
consts.comment: She can negate at will the flying or levitating abilities of any creature within 12 inches

consts.name: udp2AerFeatherFallChancePct
consts.comment: A falling elf who calls her name aloud has a 2 percent chance of a feather fall just before striking the ground

consts.name: udp2AerQuestGeasDaysMin
consts.comment: The beneficiary is quested and geased within the next 2-7 days: the minimum 2

consts.name: udp2AerQuestGeasDaysMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 7

consts.name: udp2EreHeightMinInches
consts.comment: His favorite tactic: changing his height to any size between one inch

consts.name: udp2EreHeightMaxFeet
consts.comment: and six feet

consts.name: udp2EreSwordBonus
consts.comment: He carries a +4 longsword

consts.name: udp2EreSummonMax
consts.comment: He may summon up to twenty leprechauns, sprites, pixies, or other small mischievous elf-like beings

consts.name: udp2EreChaosCastsPerRound
consts.comment: He can cast the spells chaos and polymorph any object once per round at will

consts.name: udp2SolLongbowBonus
consts.comment: His only weapon is a +5 longbow with a range as far as the horizon

consts.name: udp2SolSurpriseRadiusInches
consts.comment: He cannot be surprised by any being within 48 inches of him

consts.name: udp2SolArrowCraftDays
consts.comment: It takes one day to make one of his special arrows of slaying

consts.name: udp2SolArrowBonus
consts.comment: The special arrow of slaying is +3

consts.name: udp2SolSlayingArrowChancePct
consts.comment: An extraordinary worshiper has a 2 percent chance of being given an arrow of slaying of the normal sort

consts.name: udp2HanBathEnhanceDays
consts.comment: Bathing in the Evergold enhances her charisma score for one day

consts.name: udp2HanReactionBonusPct
consts.comment: During that day she receives a +75 percent reaction bonus

consts.name: udp2HanAweMaxLevel
consts.comment: and inspires awe in characters of up to 14th level

consts.name: udp2HanAuraRadiusInches
consts.comment: She has a magical aura of 6 inches radius

consts.name: udp2HanAuraSaveMod
consts.comment: Beings within the aura must save versus spell at -4 each round or be permanently charmed by her beauty

consts.name: udp2HanAttackWeaponMin
consts.comment: She may only be attacked by beings with a +2 or better weapon

consts.name: udp2HanAttackChaMin
consts.comment: and a negative charisma, from -1

consts.name: udp2HanAttackChaMax
consts.comment: to -7

consts.name: udp2HanChaGift
consts.comment: An elven worshiper may once in a lifetime be granted a two-charisma-point increase with respect to the opposite sex

consts.name: udp2HanChaGiftChancePct
consts.comment: There is a 5 percent chance of the charisma gift following a great quest

consts.name: udp2LabRobeColorCount
consts.comment: He wears pale-colored robes of green, blue, white, and gray - four colors

consts.name: udp2LabStasisPerRound
consts.comment: Once per round his gaze can place a being within 12 inches in temporal stasis, no saving throw, for as long as desired

consts.name: udp2LabStasisRadiusInches
consts.comment: The temporal stasis gaze reaches 12 inches

consts.name: udp2LabAgeYearsMax
consts.comment: At a touch he can restore youth to or prematurely age any being by up to 100 years in either direction, save versus spell applicable

consts.name: udp2LabSlowHasteRadiusInches
consts.comment: All mortal enemies within 18 inches are slowed automatically, and mortal allies in the same radius are hastened if he chooses; no saving throw, though magic resistance could help

consts.name: udp2LabAgeUndoChancePct
consts.comment: Worshipers may appeal to undo the effects of age, but this is a 1 percent chance, only after an outstanding quest in his name

bools.name: udp2AerFeatheredAppearance
bools.comment: A tall elf-like woman with feathered hair and eyebrows, a pair of large bird-like wings springing from her back

bools.name: udp2AerFeathersChangeColor
bools.comment: Her feathers are of constantly changing color

bools.name: udp2AerNeverTouchesGround
bools.comment: The lower half of her body vanishes into a misty whirlwind, so she appears to never touch the ground

bools.name: udp2AerWandersWithWinged
bools.comment: She wanders the winds of the planes of Olympus and Gladsheim in the company of a large number of winged creatures of many types

bools.name: udp2AerSummonsObeyUntoDeath
bools.comment: Her summoned creatures will obey her unto death

bools.name: udp2AerAirSpellsAtWill
bools.comment: Her air and weather spells may be used as often as desired, one spell per round

bools.name: udp2AerWorshipAlignments
bools.comment: Any elves of non-lawful and non-evil alignment may worship her

bools.name: udp2AerWeatherCult
bools.comment: Elves desiring certain weather conditions make the most frequent sacrifices to her, and her cult is popular with flying-mount owners (griffons, hippogriffs, pegasi)

bools.name: udp2AerGiftNeedsNoWorship
bools.comment: The feather fall beneficiaries need not be her worshipers, but should be of the same alignment

bools.name: udp2AerGiftGeasesNoSave
bools.comment: The quest and geas come with no saving throws allowed, within the stated days, commensurate with the character's level, and comparatively challenging

bools.name: udp2EreSmallFollowing
bools.comment: His following is not as large as those of the other elven deities, though thieves give him attention

bools.name: udp2EreFickleUnpredictable
bools.comment: A fickle, utterly unpredictable deity who can change his appearance at will

bools.name: udp2ErePranksRarelyHarmful
bools.comment: He enjoys causing trouble for its own sake, but his pranks are rarely either helpful or deadly

bools.name: udp2EreAlwaysWearsGreen
bools.comment: Regardless of how he appears, he will always wear green somewhere upon his person

bools.name: udp2EreSwordOpensAll
bools.comment: His longsword knocks open all barriers, doors, and locks with but a touch

bools.name: udp2EreSummonsMaxHitPoints
bools.comment: His summoned small beings each have maximum hit points

bools.name: udp2ErePrefersEscape
bools.comment: He will rarely fight another being directly, preferring to escape and catch his opponent off guard later

bools.name: udp2EreCastsBeforeCombat
bools.comment: Prior to entering combat it is very likely he makes extensive use of his chaos and polymorph spells

bools.name: udp2EreFollowersIndependent
bools.comment: His followers are quite unpredictable themselves and very independent, many of them thieves

bools.name: udp2EreAllowsOddCombos
bools.comment: Elven cleric/thieves and fighter/cleric/thieves are known among his worshipers, class combinations not normally possible to elvenkind

bools.name: udp2EreCombosAlwaysNpcs
bools.comment: These multi-classed characters are always non-player characters

bools.name: udp2SolCloakOfLeaves
bools.comment: Clad in a great cloak of living leaves

bools.name: udp2SolHuntsEvil
bools.comment: He strides through the forests in search of game and to seek out and destroy evil

bools.name: udp2SolNeverCloses
bools.comment: He will not close to do battle with an enemy, but will track and pursue instead

bools.name: udp2SolNeverEmptyQuiver
bools.comment: firing arrows from a never-empty quiver

bools.name: udp2SolTouchAndRetreat
bools.comment: His favorite tactic against a dangerous foe: physically touch the being and then retreat, then manufacture a special arrow of slaying designed to kill that one opponent

bools.name: udp2SolArrowKillsToDemigod
bools.comment: The special arrow can kill any intended target of up to, but not including, demigod status

bools.name: udp2SolArrowBeatsMagicRes
bools.comment: Demons, devils, and other lower-planar monsters have felt these missiles; not even their magic resistance protects them from certain death

bools.name: udp2SolForestInvisible
bools.comment: Traveling through forests he becomes automatically invisible, as in improved invisibility (the 4th-level illusionist spell), and completely silent

bools.name: udp2SolTaughtHiding
bools.comment: He taught the first elves the art of hiding in and moving through natural foliage undetected

bools.name: udp2SolGiftOncePerLife
bools.comment: The slaying-arrow gift can be received only once in an elf's lifetime, designed to slay the creature that is the elf's greatest enemy at the time

bools.name: udp2HanMostlyFeminine
bools.comment: Predominantly depicted as feminine, though on rare occasions said to have appeared as a male

bools.name: udp2HanSpheresLoveBeauty
bools.comment: She influences the spheres of love and beauty and is widely revered by many of the elves

bools.name: udp2HanEvergoldPool
bools.comment: She owns an immense crystal fountain and pool with which she keeps watch over her followers, as if using a crystal ball

bools.name: udp2HanBonusElvesOnly
bools.comment: Her bath bonuses are only effective against elves and half-elves

bools.name: udp2HanAphroditeShares
bools.comment: Aphrodite is the only other being who shares the waters of Evergold, gaining the same bonuses against humans

bools.name: udp2HanCultsCoexist
bools.comment: The two goddesses rarely find themselves at odds; their cults rarely assist one another but do not object to each other's presence

bools.name: udp2HanNoPhysicalAttack
bools.comment: She has no physical attack mode as such

bools.name: udp2HanAuraCharms
bools.comment: Beings within her aura who fail the save are permanently charmed by her beauty

bools.name: udp2HanOthersAlwaysMiss
bools.comment: All other attackers are so distracted by her presence as to miss her with every hit

bools.name: udp2HanChaGiftPermanent
bools.comment: The charisma increase with respect to the opposite sex is permanent, granted once during the worshiper's lifetime

bools.name: udp2HanQuestShape
bools.comment: The quest might involve the creation or preservation of a beautiful object, or mighty deeds done in the name of a loved one for the loved one's benefit

bools.name: udp2LabBothGenders
bools.comment: Like Corellon Larethian, he variously appears as both male or female, and sometimes both or neither

bools.name: udp2LabSilveryHair
bools.comment: Regardless of gender, he always has silvery hair and misty gray eyes

bools.name: udp2LabBlessedLongevity
bools.comment: At the creation of the elven races he blessed them with longevity and pronounced that the passage of time would do little to alter their appearances as it did the other races

bools.name: udp2LabKnowsEveryElf
bools.comment: He knows the future and past of every elf and all elven-related creatures

bools.name: udp2LabMasterOfTime
bools.comment: He is acknowledged by the elves to be the master of time and aging

bools.name: udp2LabStasisNoSave
bools.comment: The temporal stasis gaze carries no saving throw and lasts as long as desired

bools.name: udp2LabAgeOncePerCreature
bools.comment: The youth or aging power is used only once, one form or the other, on a creature during its lifetime

bools.name: udp2LabSlowHasteNoSave
bools.comment: The slow and haste effects carry no saving throw, though magic resistance could help

bools.name: udp2LabTimeImmune
bools.comment: He is immune to any spell or effect that involves time or would inhibit his movement (time stop, temporal stasis, slow, paralysis, hold)

bools.name: udp2LabUndoAgeRare
bools.comment: The age-undoing appeal is granted only to those who have done an outstanding quest in his name

bools.name: udp2LabQuestArtifacts
bools.comment: Such quests usually involve the recovery of artifacts and relics lost for hundreds or thousands of years

bools.name: udp2LabFollowersHistorians
bools.comment: His followers are usually historians or others who collect information on the past history of elvenkind
